scope: Kaby i5-8250U Qwen3 Q8_0 no-bias down-proj runtime descriptor contract after SLM-CPU-198
required_before_runtime_selection: Wire the descriptor into FeedForward::apply_linear without changing default runtime selection.

Emit descriptor identity in strict receipts for every selected role: model SHA, quant format, manifest SHA, role ID, layer, scope, linear, bias_present=false, candidate path, candidate kernel, selected path, selected kernel, runtime gate state, and fallback=false.
Capture fresh paired before/after strict warm-session receipts with BITNET_DENSE_NO_BIAS_LINEAR_ENABLE disabled and explicitly enabled.

Prove unchanged prompt IDs or prompt ID hashes, generated IDs, decoded text, model SHA, tokenizer source/strictness, selected_backend=cpu-rust, runtime_api=cpu, fallback=false, and dense path identity.
Fail closed for missing, duplicate, unknown, contradictory, wrong quant, wrong model, wrong role, or bias_present=true evidence.
claim_boundary: SLM-CPU-199 defines the descriptor contract only; it does not execute the no-bias candidate in normal inference.
Normal inference still selects eager_f32_candle with dense-f32-candle-linear.
The descriptor contract is necessary but not sufficient for runtime selection; future runtime use still requires descriptor wiring and fresh before/after strict receipts.
No allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, Q4/Q5 runtime support, server, GPU/NPU/OpenVINO/UHD 620, Qwen3.5, or BitNet QK256 behavior is claimed.
must_not_claim: The no-bias dense linear candidate is selected by default.
Normal inference executes the no-bias candidate.
Runtime compute selection changes by default.
Descriptor contract alone proves unchanged generated IDs or decoded text.
Allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, broad decode latency, prefill latency, model-load latency, or warm-session end-to-end speedup is proven.
Q4_K_M or Q4_K_S runtime support exists.
Server, GPU, NPU, OpenVINO, or UHD 620 execution is involved.
Qwen3.5 or hybrid architecture support is in scope.
